'''Randun Ard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]], where he would fight during the [[Battle of Corellia]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] Randun Ard and his men were hired by [[Junia Tavrak]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to eliminate the rebelling [[Corellian Security Force]] officers in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. However, Randun and his squad were ambushed in an attack on the Coronet Spaceport, and Tavrak later enlisted an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] strike team to stop the CorSec, despite Randun Ard's assurances that he could do it, if he had been given a second chance.

==Equipment==
Randun Ard used a brown and silver [[Mandalorian Seeker armor]] and a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|Blaster pistol]] during his time in the [[Battle of Corellia]].

==Behind the scenes==
Randun Ard first appeared in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. While Randun Ard does share the last name as the Mandalorian woman, [[Dalash Ard]], it is unclear if the two are apart of the same Clan or not.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
